commands: lsuser -a login rlogin shell account_locked ALL
blurb: This check confirms the built-in bin account cannot be used to sign in to the system. It passes when the account is absent or locked, with local login, remote login, and command-shell access all turned off. If the account stays open, bin owns many trusted system programs, so an attacker who logs in as bin gains an interactive shell and a direct way to alter those files.
